budgetyourtripProxy.sourceTitle: How Much Do Hotels Cost in Madrid? Hotel Prices for Madrid, Spain | Budget Your Trip
budgetyourtripProxy.evidenceText: $71 is the average price of the 128 1-star hotels in Madrid; hotel prices are in US Dollars before taxes. BudgetYourTrip's Madrid cost page reports an average price for two people for a typical double-occupancy hotel room of $177 (€155).
budgetyourtripProxy.referencePeriod: Search results retrieved 2026-08-01; source page uses current listing sample.
budgetyourtripProxy.reason: Source-defined class average retained as a proxy only; it is not a directly observed two-adult booking quote.
